fixes.explanation: The pillar of cloud, friend? It never shows up in these verses. What the LORD says is, "The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it…" (Numbers 2:2). So every family gets a spot around that one center. I can barely get my six cookie cutter kids to line up on one counter, so this is impressive.

problems.problem: The passage says the Israelites camp around the Tent of Meeting, but it does not say their spots face the center.
